sample_unit: AI-generated responses (120 scenarios x 3 runs x 4 models)

links.outcome: Between-run response consistency across three repeated generations per scenario
links.effect: Consistency was greatest for GPT-5 and Claude; Gemini and Copilot showed greater between-run variability.
links.quote: Response consistency was greatest for GPT-5 and Claude, whereas Gemini and Copilot exhibited greater between-run variability.

links.outcome: Hallucination rate, including hallucinated references, in LLM nutritional recommendations
links.quote: GPT-5 also demonstrated the lowest hallucination rate (4.4%), compared with Claude (6.1%), Gemini (10.8%), and Copilot (17.9%).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the clinical performance, safety, and hallucination rates of several LLMs across 120 clinical scenarios in dental implant nutrition, evaluated offline by expert clinicians. It does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
